name: Caoilte mac Rónáin

attributes.attribute: hero of the Fianna under the standard spelling Caílte

text: Caoilte mac Rónáin is a later spelling of Caílte, the celebrated hero of the Fianna. This modern form normalises the older name for present-day readers of Irish. The full story of the warrior appears under the main spelling Caílte.

okr.objective: Record Caoilte mac Rónáin as a modern spelling of the hero Caílte.
